title: durability journal entry
description: One step record in an append-only durability journal — a single JSON object per line. The replay log a killed loop reads to skip a side-effecting step it already completed (framework/loop/durability.md). The store and path are instance-owned; the framework hardcodes neither. Append-only NDJSON; the latest matching entry wins.

ts.description: When this step record was written (ISO 8601, injected from the runtime clock).

task_id.description: The ledger task id this step belongs to.

step.description: The named step within the task's run (e.g. claim, dispatch, verify, complete, escalate). Instance-defined; the framework fixes no set.

attempt.description: Which implement→verify attempt this record belongs to (the bounded-reiteration index).

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic key for a side-effecting step: hash(task_id + step + salient_inputs). Re-execution with the same key must be a no-op at the side-effect boundary; replay matches on it.

result.description: Step outcome. start = begun (not yet done); ok/pass = completed successfully (replay-eligible); fail = ran but failed; skipped-replay = short-circuited because a prior ok was found.

evidence.description: Pointer to proof — a result-file path, an exit code, a log location. Never the raw payload (data-handling.md).

metadata.description: Instance escape hatch for extra structured fields. Must carry no secrets.
